forehead.units: pixels in the original 1254x1254 side art after pupil-to-mouth-corner similarity registration; increasing x is anterior
forehead.region: visible skin outline from reference y=300 through 450, inclusive, every 5 px

temple_pigment.comparison: 52 and 53 use the previous guide projection; revisions 54 onward exclude sampled hair from the skin pigment at the two temples. 53 isolates the subsequent pigment fix on the exposed forehead. At covered positions the dressed render includes real hair, shadows and lighting.
temple_pigment.units: 8-bit sRGB. Albedo is the median of 3x3 texels from the embedded WayfarerSkin material in each generated GLB after a skin-only raycast; raw frame colour is the median of 7x7 pixels after two-point camera registration.

bare_skin_control.source: Pinned idle pose, identical camera, native skin material, all hair and costume sections hidden; median of 9x9 raw pixels in sRGB.

forehead.mesh_projection_uncertainty: Each frame uses its own 2-point registration. The 54 and 55 head position/UV/index buffers are byte-identical. Their registered median mesh errors (0.81 and 2.60 reference px) differ because the detected pupil and mouth corner move by 1–2 raw pixels; both raw-image medians are 1.50 px.

hairline_and_camera.coordinates: top-left origin, x right, y down; measurements from registered 88-degree crop
hairline_and_camera.projection_limit: A similarity transform alone cannot compensate 88-degree perspective or unknown guide lens; crown/bun are not cranial bone.
hairline_and_camera.registration: near pupil and mouth corner; one scale, rotation and translation; no local warp or relighting
hairline_and_camera.hairline_y_method: at fixed x, average five columns; first 8/9 samples with R>125, R-G>14, R-B>28, G>80; measures optically exposed skin, not exact follicles
hairline_and_camera.bare_forehead_x_method: at fixed y, average five rows; last registered skin-to-background transition in x=975..1039, R>140, R-G>15, R-B>26, G-B<22; validate against diagnostic markers
hairline_and_camera.preauricular_contrast_method: x585..730, 5 rows; luminance drop vs 15px median neighborhood; local fine-dark contrast only, includes ear detail

recording.source: Native Windows Unreal standalone window. Registered by edge patterns on frames from the same returning orbit.

temple_detail_motion.description: Framewise motion-compensated residual in skin-toned, textured areas of the close temple, covering both outward and returning sweeps from 15 to 99 degrees. Excludes duplicate/near-still pairs. Gray pixel levels, 0 to 255. Lower values indicate less high-frequency variation after optical flow. Includes camera rendering and video encoding.

temple_fibers.scene: Shrine portrait, 2560x1440 raw Unreal still, 88-degree camera yaw.
temple_fibers.reference_alignment: Side illustration aligned by pupil and mouth-corner landmarks. Fiber placement may differ.

method.lightness: D65 CIELAB L* from sRGB; trough depth relative to adjacent exposed skin.
method.directional_support: Nine-pixel continuous line with four-pixel transverse flanks; strongest median bound across nine slopes.
method.count_unit: Crossings of the sampling lines. A long fiber can cross more than one line.

leading_fiber_lane_spacing.description: 88-degree view in native pixels. Up to two actual dark troughs paired to the two projected material lanes within +/-6 px. Each of 12 horizontal sections covers y=720 through 830, spaced 10 px apart. A zero gap means both predictions select the same visible trough.

interior_between_candidate_lanes.description: Horizontal region between the candidate material lanes, excluding six pixels at either edge. Identical image-space sample positions in all four panels.

interior_between_revision_54_lanes.description: Same broad interval left bare by the widely separated 54 guides, applied to ALL panels, with six pixels omitted at each edge.

root_to_tip_earlobe.description: 88-degree native image coordinates. Measured against a +/-6 px corridor around each mesh-projected material lane. Dark troughs must persist along nine pixels, exceed 2 CIELAB L*, and recur in at least three of four neighboring scanlines at four-pixel spacing. Bare skin, earring and cap are excluded. Tabulated RGB is mean sRGB flank minus core in 8-bit channel steps. Late numerical matches in intersecting strands are an optical neighborhood measurement, not an identity claim.
root_to_tip_earlobe.interpretation: The two original opaque wire families and the two replacement translucent material lanes are separate geometries in the same preauricular region. Fractions index each geometry independently. A geometry extending below the lobe may fade out above it.

lower_strand_sweep.description: Direction-supported lines across x960..1169 in the exposed region immediately anterior to the earring. Y measured in common registered image coordinates. The game lobe ends near y976; the aligned art lobe ends near y1018.

dressed_anterior_vault.region: visible front hair silhouette from y=10 to 80 in the cropped 1254 px side guide; does not measure anatomical skull height
